concepts.simple_definition: Natural resources and conflicts over resources UNIT SUMMARY The land is considered as an area of the Earth’s surface embracing all aspects of the biotic and abiotic components existing on, above, and below the surface of the Earth
concepts.deep_explanation: Plants and animals of the biosphere, gases of the atmosphere, the underlying geology and soils as well as the hydrology, plus the results of past and present activities of human beings are attributes of land or considered to be part of the land
